items.title: Rebelde Way Season 1 (2002)
items.description: Rebelde Way is an Argentine telenovela created and produced by Cris Morena. It was originally broadcast on Azul Televisión from 27 May 2002 to 10 November 2003.

items.title: Rebelde Way - Episode 1 with English Subtitles (High Quality)
items.description:
This is episode 1 (Season 1) of the Argentinian TV series "Rebelde Way" (2002), starring Camila Bordonaba, Benjamin Rojas, Luisana Lopilato, and Felipe Colombo. The spoken language is Spanish (Espanol) and English subtitles have been embedded into the video.
